---
name: Incorrect Information Report
about: Report outdated, inaccurate, or broken information in our civic data
title: '[DATA] '
labels: civic-data, bug
assignees: ''

---

**Service Name**
Which service is this regarding? (e.g., Birth Certificate, Aadhaar update)

**What is wrong?**
- [ ] Outdated information
- [ ] Incorrect requirement
- [ ] Broken link
- [ ] Missing information
- [ ] Other

**Describe the incorrect information**
Please explain what is currently listed on CivicBridge and why it is incorrect.

**Provide the correct information (if known)**
Please provide the updated or correct information.

**Official Source**
Please provide a link to the official government website or verified source that confirms the correct information.
